Hello Tycoons! 

Today we’re coming to you with a new RCTW UPDATE! In this week’s update you’ll find an Alpha version of our brand-new SCENARIO EDITOR, allowing you to build custom scenarios from your saved games!  You can start creating fun and challenging scenarios for you and your friends today, and with a future update you’ll be able to share your scenarios through our UGC system! Additionally, the patch contains a host of under-the-hood improvements to AI, Performance, Water reflections, heatmaps, and paths, along with two new Scenarios and a rocking new Flatride - the Theater!

[h1]SCENARIO EDITOR – ALPHA VERSION[/h1]
For the first time in RCTW, you’ll now be able to create your own custom scenarios. Today is just the first step of this easy-to-use new feature. Simply build a park in Sandbox mode, enter the “Scenario” mode from the main menu and click “Create New Scenario.” From there you can adjust objectives including park value and rating, guest satisfaction, ride quality and many more, seamlessly creating custom scenarios to play out in your Sandbox park. In our next update, you will be able to upload your scenarios via our UGC System to test other players’ skills, or download scenarios you find in the workshop. As a reminder - this is an ALPHA VERSION of this feature and we really need your feedback so please be sure to provide it in our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]Feedback Forum[/url]. 

Addtionally, we’ve added two more pre-made Scenarios, bringing the total number up to 8! Give them a whirl!

[h1]FLATRIDE[/h1]
Get Ready to ROCK!  Give your peeps a blast of rock’n’roll with our new THEATRE attraction flatride. This new family ride features an open-air auditorium with a full band rocking brand-new music on stage. Your peeps will line up for the concert, sit down, and enjoy the show. Get your lighters ready and check out a screenshot below.

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/TheaterRide_01.jpg[/img]

[h1]PERFORMANCE IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
As always, we’re continuing to optimize, improve and tweak features from our last updates. Our work on optimization of assets continues and will mean further performance as welll as visual improvements.

In this update you’ll also find path fixes, improved water features, improved AI heatmaps, and general bug, performance and animation improvements. Please continue to let us know about any other bugs and tech issues you find!

[h1]PARK STAFF - HEAT MAPS[/h1]

With today's update we are further expanding our Staff Heat Maps feature. Now, when you add a new Park Staff building to your park, your park will enter into “heat map mode”, making it effortless  to locate other buildings of the same type in your park. To further refine your park layout, you can turn individual Park Staff heat maps on and off by navigating to your Heat Maps menu. 

[h1]COMING SOON[/h1]
Be on the lookout in our coming updates for improvements to our staff heatmaps, and enhanced patrol zone controls for park staff. Also, as you play through this new build you’ll notice that we’ve greyed out a few new options within RCTW. Without giving too much away, we're working on an exciting new roller coaster, UGC Mode for the Scenario Editor, and a few surprises along the way! Stay tuned!

Lastly, we’d like to give sincere thanks for the kind words about our last patch. With your support, feedback, and inspiration, the team is working tirelessly to make RCTW better and better. 

Please continue to give us [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]feedback[/url], [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]report bugs[/url], and [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]discuss[/url] RCTW in our Official Forums.

- Team RCTW

--------------------------------------------

[h1][u][b]Here is the full list of today's updates:[/b][/u][/h1]

[b][u]NEW FEATURES/CONTENT:[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]FLATRIDE:[/b] [i]Rock out with our new Theater Ride![/i]   Its an awesome new flatride that entertains dozens of peeps available to all.
[*][b]SCENARIOS:[/b] [i]Today we are launching 2 brand new scenarios: #7 and #8.[/i] Give them a try![/list]

[b][u]ALPHA FEATURES:[/u][/b]
This list contains features that are in-progress, have had a first pass at improvements, or are at an Alpha stage.[list]
[*][b]SCENARIOS: ALPHA FEATURE:[/b] [i]Scenario Editor[/i] - Today we are launching our Alpha Version of the Scenario Editor! Simply create a map in Sandbox mode, save it, and then go into the Scenarios section of the Main Menu to turn your save into a Scenario. This is an Alpha Feature and we expect to expand upon it further. Our plan is to next create a mode where you will be able to share scenarios via UGC with friends![/list]

[b][u]IMPROVEMENTS:[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]BUILDINGS:[/b] Following optimization and graphical improvements we have re-enabled fountains in the game
[*][b]BUILDINGS:[/b] The Intensity Factor has been rebalanced across all rides
[*][b]COASTERS:[/b] The seats on the hypercoaster have been improved
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] We have further improved the visual look of water based on your feedback so please be sure to check it out!
[*][b]PATHS:[/b] Paths have been further improved with a specific focus on end-path connections.
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Improved the logic for peeps choosing different rollercoasters.
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Peep Hunger and Thirst Generation has been further tweaked
[*][b]PERFORMANCE:[/b] We have continued optimizing assets in the game, leading to further performance gains in this build
[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] We have further improved the multi-item delete functionality based on your feedback[/list]

[b][u]BUG FIXES:[/u][/b]
[b]The Bugs below have all been fixed in this latest update.[/b][i] Note that this is only a selection of all the bug fixes from the full list.[/i][list]
[*][b]BUILDINGS - The 'Western Lamp Post' does not emit any light.
[*][b]BUILDINGS:[/b] Scenery fence 'Lighted Iron Brick fence' texture issue
[*][b]CAMPAIGN:[/b] Scenery icon remains greyed out when allowing a ride to break down prior to addressing the Scenery tutorials.
[*][b]CAMPAIGN:[/b] User is unable to complete the 'Queues - Get the peeps on your rides!' objective.
[*][b]COASTERS:[/b] Selecting the 'Roller Coaster' UI on the tool bar after closing any other UI, opens up the previously closed UI.
[*][b]COASTERS:[/b] The premade coaster 'Cosmic Runner' under the 'Hyper Coaster' fails to pass the 'Test'.
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] LOD2 problems on flatride Orbit Spin
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] One specific Peep always keeps his shadow when zooming out 
[*][b]SCENARIOS:[/b] Objectives tab is not synchronized with the end of scenario 4 pop-up
[*][b]SCENARIOS:[/b] Scenario 01 - Objectives - Percentage for 'Have 3 months were Park Revenue exceeds $ 4000' objective display 33% even if the Park revenue of none of the months exceeds above $4000.
[*][b]SCENARIOS:[/b] Scenario 3 - Gold medal objective is automatically completed if completing the silver medal objective.
[*][b]SCENARIOS:[/b] Scenarios do not always unlock
[*][b]UGC:[/b] Under 'Most Recent' tab, user can only view new most recently added content when viewing 50 contents per page.
[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] Major sound distortion when deleting several items at the same time with Mass Delete.
[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] Setting the [Reflections] in the Custom Settings will override all changes when selecting [Low], [Medium], or [High] settings.
[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] The price continues to increase or decrease when clicking the [+] or [-] buttons whilst closing the info window.`
[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] User is unable to close the tier - 3 UI using on screen cross 'X' button or 'Esc' key on the keyboard, if user toggles 'ON/OFF' the HUD visible using the shortcut key 'H'.[/list]

[u][b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b][/u]
We are still working on a number of bugs, tweaks, and other fixes. With each update we address a number of bugs and make improvements, but sometimes this may cause other features to break in the process. Our focus during Early Access is on releasing updates faster to you so we can get feedback earlier in the process. If you see a bug please report it in our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]Bug Tracker[/url]. Feedback on what you see implemented should go in our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]Improvement Tracker[/url]. 

For a general guide on fixes and troubleshooting steps for common issues (including the 57% bug) please visit [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=660997633]THIS USER GENERATED GUIDE[/url]. Note that we have been seeing a number of users reporting issues with computers that are below the game’s minimum specs, so please check the main steam page before playing to ensure you meet the requirements. Additionally, we have seen a number of problems are solved when users update their graphics drivers. 

Lastly, downloads via Steam may sometimes get corrupted or updates don’t fully install leading to odd behaviors in game and starting the game. Try these steps to Verify the game cache:[olist]
[*]Right click RollerCoaster Tycoon World in Steam 
[*]Click Properties 
[*]Then Open the Local Files tab 
[*]Click Verify integrity of game cache[/olist]
[i]NOTE: In general – it is a good idea to Verify the Integrity of the Game Cache after any update just to be sure.[/i]

notes.title: RCTW - Early Access - Dev Blog #9 - Update #6 Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,

Today we have an amazing visual update  in store for you, along with a number of smaller items that you have been asking for. The visual improvement alone will dramatically change your experience playing the game. As always, many other parts of the game have been updated including Paths, AI, Audio, Graphics, New Scenarios, and Performance, but the real star of the show is our brand-new Skybox! Check it out:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/20160607120936_1a.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW SKYBOX[/h1] 
In today’s update we are launching our new Skybox. As you can see above, it’s been completely overhauled, meaning that the entire game gets a significant visual upgrade along with it. Along with these lighting and color improvements, we have also added a beautiful sunrise and sunset sequence as well. Your game will go through a full day cycle, from daylight to sunset to night to sunrise. The effect is much more realistic and smooth, and it enhances the look and feel of everything else in the game. The new skybox would not have been possible without your feedback, so thank you so much for your comments and suggestions. We’d especially like to thank our testers who have been working with this new skybox for a bit and helping us tweak it. Now it’s your turn to tell us what you think!

[h1]NEW SCENARIOS[/h1]
Today’s patch also includes brand-new Scenarios 4, 5, and 6. These scenarios give players the chance to experience exciting new gameplay challenges. We also spent time refining and tweaking Scenarios 1, 2, and 3 so be sure to check them all out.

[h1]MASS DELETE TOOL – ALPHA FEATURE[/h1]
A top fan request – a mass delete tool – has be added to the game and is ready for you to test in Alpha mode. When you click the bulldozer now you will have the option to select multiple items to delete at one time, and you can change the area that you delete by zooming in and out. It’s fast, easy, and a very clean way to mass delete items in the game. Let us know what you think and know that we plan to further refine it in the future.

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/20160607121922_1.jpg[/img]

[h1]ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE[/h1]
We have continued our work on AI with this patch with a focus on the Park Rating System as well as the Marketing System. Both should now give more accurate information about your park. Each system has been refined and balanced to give a better gameplay experience. 

Additionally, we know there were some issues with the way peeps chose their rides, so we improved an algorithm associated with informing a peep how novel a particular ride is and factoring it into their decision making – this should really improve the dynamism with which the peeps move about your park. 

[h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]
 
We are aware of performance issues affecting some players, and are working hard to optimize and improve framerates. In this update you will notice a number of general performance improvements, as we have further continued our work on in-game object optimization from our prior update (particularly around Flatrides) along with general environmental improvements. 

[h1]PATHS[/h1]
Our team is spending  more time improving the path system and responding to your feedback. You will notice in today’s update that we have completed a number of upgrades to the path deletion and placement algorithms that should build upon what we launched with our last update.

[h1]STAFF HEATMAPS – ALPHA FEATURE[/h1]
Last but certainly not least we are launching the very first version (Stage One) of Staff Heatmaps. At this stage you are now able to click the Heatmaps button and view where your current staff are and their associated buildings. This system is the first element we are launching from our larger Staff Patrol Areas system that we will be rolling out in future updates. We know staff management was a huge part of the previous games and we are refocusing attention to the system. It’s been re-thought from the ground up and we have heard your feedback so be sure to stay tuned to future updates to see it come into the game! Check out stage one of Staff Heatmaps by going to the Heatmaps tab in the game. 

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/20160607125537_1a.jpg[/img]

The team now has their sights set on our next big update. It’s a doozy, packed with new content, improved performance, new features, further improvements, and other tweaks! As always, your input is driving our roadmap and decisions, so we need you to keep it coming! For just this reason, we have shifted development to release new features more quickly, and in some cases early stages of development. It allows us to pivot and fix a feature or tweak before it goes too far into development. 

We thank you for all the continued [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]support[/url], [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]feedback[/url] and [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]bug reports[/url]!

-Team RCTW

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/20160607121315_1.jpg[/img]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h1][b][u]Here is the full list of today’s updates:[/u][/b][/h1]

[b][u]NEW FEATURES AND CONTENT:[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] [i]Incredible new Skydome added to the game![/i] Enjoy the new sunrises and sunsets now available across all maps. 
[*][b]SCENARIOS:[/b] [i]Three New Scenarios have been unlocked for you to try out![/i] Check out all new Scenarios 4, 5, and 6![/list]
[b][u]IMPROVEMENTS:[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]BUILDINGS:[/b] Assets will only appear as a ghost if they have not fully loaded yet
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] Improved the textures on the "Golden Entrance"
[*][b]PATHS:[/b] Further improvements to path deletion and placement
[*][b]PATHS:[/b] Improved the UI for choosing between Curved and Straight Paths
[*][b]PATHS:[/b] Removed the green highlight around already-placed paths
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Improved the algorithm associated with Peeps choosing a ride based on novelty
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Improved the logic and balance for peeps when choosing what coaster to ride
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Improved the Park Rating system and resolved a number of bugs/balance issues
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Peeps now trigger specific thoughts when in the "ill" state 
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Removed the increase cap for in-game marketing and resolved a number of bugs/balance issues
[*][b]PERFORMANCE:[/b] First pass of optimizations on environment
[*][b]PERFORMANCE:[/b] Further optimizations to flatrides
[*][b]PERFORMANCE:[/b] Sunrays are now disabled when not visible by the user
[*][b]PERFORMANCE:[/b] Terrain will now have tessellation according to camera height
[*][b]PERFROMANCE:[/b] Improved the Global Illumination algorithm to improve performance
[*][b]SCENARIOS:[/b] Number of balance and other tweaks to scenarios 1,2, and 3
[*][b]UGC:[/b] Added a "Subscribed Items Filter" to the UGC manager in-game[/list]
[b][u]ALPHA FEATURES:[/u][/b]
This list contains features that are in-progress, have had a first pass at improvements, or are at an Alpha stage. [list]
[*][b]UI/UX: ALPHA FEATURE:[/b] [i]Staff Heatmaps[/i] - You can now see all your staff in your park and what they are up to using heatmap view!
[*][b]UI/UX: ALPHA FEATURE:[/b] [i]Multi-Item Delete[/i] - You can now simply hover over or select multiple items to delete at once. [/list]
[b][u]BUG FIXES:[/u][/b]
[b]The Bugs below have all been fixed in this latest update.[/b] [i]Note that this is a selection of all bug fixes from the full list.[/i][list]
[*][b]BUILDINGS:[/b] Entrance and Exit nodes on coaster stations do not align
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] Graphic options can fail to update and save properly
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] Issue with the texture at the base of the Drop Zone ride
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] Leaves and branches of the Palm Tree disappear upon placing it when the camera is zoomed in
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] LOD problem with the Spacewars ride
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] Silly Swing and Barnyard Bash flatride LODs are not correct
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] There are a number of path texture bugs
[*][b]PATHS:[/b] Player unable to add a path to a sloped path
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Food & Drinks items purchased by any Peep does not update in purchased list under 'Purchases Page' of peep info window.
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Food and Shops always display a popularity of 0.
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Janitor only empty trash can when there is nothing else to do
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Park Rating - 'Ride Quality' graph under the 'Park Rating' tab raise up to some level, just by placing a coaster station into the park.
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Park staff flash outside their building if they cannot reach their destination.
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Peep history is not recording consistently

notes.title: RCTW - Early Access - Dev Blog #9 - Update #6 Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,

Today we have an amazing visual update  in store for you, along with a number of smaller items that you have been asking for. The visual improvement alone will dramatically change your experience playing the game. As always, many other parts of the game have been updated including Paths, AI, Audio, Graphics, New Scenarios, and Performance, but the real star of the show is our brand-new Skybox! Check it out:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/20160607120936_1a.jpg[/img]

[h1]NEW SKYBOX[/h1] 
In today’s update we are launching our new Skybox. As you can see above, it’s been completely overhauled, meaning that the entire game gets a significant visual upgrade along with it. Along with these lighting and color improvements, we have also added a beautiful sunrise and sunset sequence as well. Your game will go through a full day cycle, from daylight to sunset to night to sunrise. The effect is much more realistic and smooth, and it enhances the look and feel of everything else in the game. The new skybox would not have been possible without your feedback, so thank you so much for your comments and suggestions. We’d especially like to thank our testers who have been working with this new skybox for a bit and helping us tweak it. Now it’s your turn to tell us what you think!

[h1]NEW SCENARIOS[/h1]
Today’s patch also includes brand-new Scenarios 4, 5, and 6. These scenarios give players the chance to experience exciting new gameplay challenges. We also spent time refining and tweaking Scenarios 1, 2, and 3 so be sure to check them all out.

[h1]MASS DELETE TOOL – ALPHA FEATURE[/h1]
A top fan request – a mass delete tool – has be added to the game and is ready for you to test in Alpha mode. When you click the bulldozer now you will have the option to select multiple items to delete at one time, and you can change the area that you delete by zooming in and out. It’s fast, easy, and a very clean way to mass delete items in the game. Let us know what you think and know that we plan to further refine it in the future.

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/20160607121922_1.jpg[/img]

[h1]ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE[/h1]
We have continued our work on AI with this patch with a focus on the Park Rating System as well as the Marketing System. Both should now give more accurate information about your park. Each system has been refined and balanced to give a better gameplay experience. 

Additionally, we know there were some issues with the way peeps chose their rides, so we improved an algorithm associated with informing a peep how novel a particular ride is and factoring it into their decision making – this should really improve the dynamism with which the peeps move about your park. 

[h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]
 
We are aware of performance issues affecting some players, and are working hard to optimize and improve framerates. In this update you will notice a number of general performance improvements, as we have further continued our work on in-game object optimization from our prior update (particularly around Flatrides) along with general environmental improvements. 

[h1]PATHS[/h1]
Our team is spending  more time improving the path system and responding to your feedback. You will notice in today’s update that we have completed a number of upgrades to the path deletion and placement algorithms that should build upon what we launched with our last update.

[h1]STAFF HEATMAPS – ALPHA FEATURE[/h1]
Last but certainly not least we are launching the very first version (Stage One) of Staff Heatmaps. At this stage you are now able to click the Heatmaps button and view where your current staff are and their associated buildings. This system is the first element we are launching from our larger Staff Patrol Areas system that we will be rolling out in future updates. We know staff management was a huge part of the previous games and we are refocusing attention to the system. It’s been re-thought from the ground up and we have heard your feedback so be sure to stay tuned to future updates to see it come into the game! Check out stage one of Staff Heatmaps by going to the Heatmaps tab in the game. 

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/20160607125537_1a.jpg[/img]

The team now has their sights set on our next big update. It’s a doozy, packed with new content, improved performance, new features, further improvements, and other tweaks! As always, your input is driving our roadmap and decisions, so we need you to keep it coming! For just this reason, we have shifted development to release new features more quickly, and in some cases early stages of development. It allows us to pivot and fix a feature or tweak before it goes too far into development. 

We thank you for all the continued [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]support[/url], [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]feedback[/url] and [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]bug reports[/url]!

-Team RCTW

notes.title: RCTW - Early Access - Update #6 News and a Sneak Peak!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,

As we discussed and showed in our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/rollercoastertycoon/v/69928040]stream on June 1st[/url], our plan was to release an update this week containing a number of visual, AI, and performance improvements. However, this update was dependent on QA and testing, and as of today the build is not quite ready to go out. The changes in this update include core technical engine improvements, so we need a bit more time to polish them up. The good news is you won’t have to wait long -  the patch is now scheduled to go live no later than next week, pending QA approval! 

That said, we wanted to tease some of the cool stuff you’ll see next week! The biggest and most noticeable change will be our brand-new skybox, shown in the screenshot below and prior stream:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/RCTW_2016-06-01_16-41-551.png[/img]

Not only did we add gorgeous new sunsets and sunrises, we also completely revamped the skybox, meaning that both daytime and nighttime effects are vastly improved. This profoundly effects the entire look and feel of the game during all times of day. We hope you like it as much as we do!

On top of that, this coming update will include an Alpha/First Stage Version of Staff Heat-Maps and a Mass Delete tool! It’s a package of really significant upgrades, and we are super excited to get it out as soon as we can!

See you next week! Thank you for all the support!

- Team RCTW

notes.title: RCTW – Early Access – Dev Blog #8 – Update #5 Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,

It’s Update Day! – Today, we’ve got a number of items that are now at the point where we can push them live to you.  Many different parts of the game have gotten an update including Paths, AI, Audio, New Content, Graphics, and even Performance! 

[h1]PATHS[/h1]

While this is by no means our final update to our path system (in fact work is continuing during this sprint) we did make a number of improvements and bug fixes  that should improve the path-building experience. It should now be much smoother and easier to place some of your paths –  this is only the start; a lot more improvements are still to come! Additionally, we are launching a new feature with our path system – the ability to change the texture after it’s placed! It’s a small but heavily requested feature that we think will make the whole system much more flexible. Let us know what you think and remember that this is only our “First Pass” on Paths – we have a ton more ideas, features, and updates we still plan on implementing!

[h1]NEW CENTERPIECE[/h1]

 Today we are also launching a brand new Scenery Centerpiece! Check out the awesome futuristic Sci-Fi Centerpiece, now available for under the centerpieces menu in your game.

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/20160519121619_1.jpg[/img]

[h1]AI[/h1]

The work we did on AI in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/282560/announcements/detail/611738777505742157][i]Previous Update[/i][/url] has been continued and further refined. You will notice great improvements to the Peep and Staff AI in this update, including improvements  in Food/Drinks/Souvenir behavior, Nausea/Bathroom Behavior, Trash Can Use, Injuries/Sickness, and Ride-seeking and pathfinding. All of these updates come together to create a much more responsive and immersive experience. Full details on what was done can be found below. Note – there is still more we are working on as we now shift our focus to expansion of behaviors and further balancing of the different systems. 

[h1]AUDIO[/h1]

This update contains a number of audio SFX improvements! This new audio is in an “Alpha Phase” as it’s very much still in-progress, but you will notice some awesome new coaster sounds as well as new environmental ambiance SFX. Our audio team is doing a top–to-bottom review and scrub of every single sound in the game. We have a renewed focus on the audio in the game and you should stay tuned for further improvements as we go through the SFX.

[h1]UGC[/h1]

Another area of the game that was improved is our UGC Hub. You will notice a refreshed layout that should let you see all of your content much easier. 

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

Graphics are much improved in this update as well. We had two key areas of focus: The first was to finish rolling out our Screen Space Reflections feature to all objects in game. We think it looks beautiful and hope you agree too! Here’s a a peak at what it looks like and how its improved water and other objects in the scene:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/ss05182016.jpg[/img]

Additionally, our team took a look at all of our Terrain Shaders and improved the system to support much higher quality terrain and better mixing of different terrains. This improvement should further add depth and immersion as you play. 

On top of this we added a nifty Depth-of-Field effect to the main park view. Objects further away will be blurry and those closer will be crystal clear. [b]This effect is DISABLED by default. To turn it on simply go to Options > Graphics  and disable the Depth–of-Field effect.[/b]

Work was also done on a number of flatrides to optimize them and also to up-res their textures [i](In Progress Work)[/i]. We won’t be highlighting them in this update blog as they’re not fully rolled out, but the results are already showing an increase in overall performance while at the same time allowing us to have gorgeous hi-res textures and smoother animations! This is available today on some of your rides and will be rolled out to the remaining rides in future updates. 

[img][/img][h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]

Last, but certainly not least, in general you should notice that your game will run a bit smoother due to the above optimizations but also due a number of other “under-the-hood” changes. More work is of course continuing on performance and we have some longer term tasks we hope to wrap up in the coming weeks to continue making the game perform better. 

It’s been an insanely busy few weeks here at Team RCTW as we work to improve the game, launch new content and features, and fix bugs. Your feedback is driving all of our decisions and we hope you like  the direction the game is taking. Be sure to continue to share your [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]thoughts[/url], [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]bug reports[/url], and more with us on our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]forums[/url].

From our Community Team, here’s a sneak peek at this week’s Community Spotlight – a park called "Timeless Isle" by user "Maulite":

[img]https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/t31.0-8/13246207_1054797834612387_5080743826880113701_o.jpg[/img]

For more screenshots from his park check out our [url=https://www.facebook.com/media/set/?set=a.1054797721279065.1073741836.121146194644227&type=3]Facebook Album[/url].

Thank you again for all the support, incredible feedback, and most importantly – the amazing and inspiring creations and parks you all are making!

Until the next post, see you on the [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]forums[/url]! In the meantime, see below for the full list of what’s contained in this update and to get a preview at what we are working on next!

Team RCTW

-----------------------------------------------------

[h1][u][b]Here is the full list of today’s updates, and a preview of what we are working on next:[/b][/u][/h1]

[b][u]NEW FEATURES AND CONTENT[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]CONTENT:[/b] [i]New Sci-Fi Centerpiece added to scenery Centerpieces.[/i] This new scenery item is a giant moon rock floating in space, with room to run your coasters through it! 
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] [i]New Terrain Shaders to improve terrain quality![/i] Check out the new terrain shaders in our Forest and other maps! Different textures blend better and the terrain looks smoother when zooming in and out. 
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] [i]Screen Space Reflections Added to All Objects in Game![/i] This vastly improves the look and feel of all the objects in the game. Everything has a reflection of its environment now and looks more realistic and tangible. 
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] [i]Depth-of-Field Effect Added to Park Cam.[/i] We added a new Depth-of-Field Effect to the park cam. Now things further away will look blurrier than those close up, giving you a better sense of depth. It is Disabled by default BUT You can ENABLE this feature at any time by going into Options > Graphics > Disable Depth of Field. The choice is yours!
[/list]
[b][u][i]IMPROVEMENTS[/i][/u][/b][list]
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] All Sci-Fi Coaster Loading Stations have new textures
[*][b]GRAPHICS:[/b] Improved the seats of all coaster cars to better fit peeps
[*][b]GRPAHICS:[/b] Improved Depth-of-Field and Field of View effects when in Ride/Coaster cam
[*][b]PATHS:[/b] Path nodes are deleted when a path is cleared
[*][b]PATHS:[/b] Paths now have more realistic incline slopes
[*][b]PEEPS: [i]AI IMPROVEMNTS LIST BY SYSTEM[/i][/b][list]
[*][i]Food, Drinks, & Souvenirs[/i][list]
[*]Peeps now have a higher chance to address their nausea, bathroom, hunger, or thirst when these stats are high.
[*]Peeps should no longer buy drinks, hoping to soothe their hunger. We have informed them that food will be much more effective for this purpose.
[*]Peeps will no longer randomize between the top five food / drink / souvenir stands, instead giving higher priority to those they like more. As a consequence, peeps should generally be happier when buying food, drinks, and souvenirs.
[/list][*][i]Injury[/i][list]
[*]Injured peeps should once again engage in their proper behaviors of sitting on benches to be addressed by Medics, or (in rare cases) leaving the park.
[/list][*][i]Nausea and Bathroom[/i][list]
[*]Peeps' minimum possible Nausea Tolerance is now 1 - no Peeps will have a 0 nausea tolerance.
[*]Peeps' Nausea Tolerance will be increased if they like riding more intense rides.
[*]Peeps should now more reliably choose a nearby bathroom if they need to either vomit or pee.
[*]Peeps should now think the thought "The paths here are disgusting" an appropriate amount.
[*]Peeps will no longer select a random bathroom.
[*]Peeps with moderately high nausea will now prefer to sit on benches to reduce it.
[*]Peeps with very high nausea will now prefer to sit on benches to reduce it, if a bathroom is far away. Some of them might try to hold it, though...
[/list][*][i]Rides[/i][list]
[*]Fixed an issue that was preventing rides from increasing riders' Energy and decreasing riders' Boredom
[*]Peeps should now more reliably ride low intensity rides. As a consequence, peeps should now distribute themselves among your park attractions more evenly.
[/list][*][i]Trash[/i][list]
[*]Peeps should now properly throw their trash out in trashcans. Trashcans have a capacity- peeps will not throw trash into full trashcans. Peeps will throw trash on the path only if they're unable to find a nearby trashcan.
[/list][/list][*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Improved Emotes and Peep Thoughts to be more descriptive and trigger more often
[*][b]PEEPS:[/b] Improved Transition of Janitor animation from Cleaning and Walking

notes.title: RCTW – Early Access – Dev Blog #8 – Update #5 Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,

It’s Update Day! – Today, we’ve got a number of items that are now at the point where we can push them live to you.  Many different parts of the game have gotten an update including Paths, AI, Audio, New Content, Graphics, and even Performance! 

[h1]PATHS[/h1]

While this is by no means our final update to our path system (in fact work is continuing during this sprint) we did make a number of improvements and bug fixes  that should improve the path-building experience. It should now be much smoother and easier to place some of your paths –  this is only the start; a lot more improvements are still to come! Additionally, we are launching a new feature with our path system – the ability to change the texture after it’s placed! It’s a small but heavily requested feature that we think will make the whole system much more flexible. Let us know what you think and remember that this is only our “First Pass” on Paths – we have a ton more ideas, features, and updates we still plan on implementing!

[h1]NEW CENTERPIECE[/h1]

 Today we are also launching a brand new Scenery Centerpiece! Check out the awesome futuristic Sci-Fi Centerpiece, now available for under the centerpieces menu in your game.

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/20160519121619_1.jpg[/img]

[h1]AI[/h1]

The work we did on AI in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/282560/announcements/detail/611738777505742157][i]Previous Update[/i][/url] has been continued and further refined. You will notice great improvements to the Peep and Staff AI in this update, including improvements  in Food/Drinks/Souvenir behavior, Nausea/Bathroom Behavior, Trash Can Use, Injuries/Sickness, and Ride-seeking and pathfinding. All of these updates come together to create a much more responsive and immersive experience. Full details on what was done can be found below. Note – there is still more we are working on as we now shift our focus to expansion of behaviors and further balancing of the different systems. 

[h1]AUDIO[/h1]

This update contains a number of audio SFX improvements! This new audio is in an “Alpha Phase” as it’s very much still in-progress, but you will notice some awesome new coaster sounds as well as new environmental ambiance SFX. Our audio team is doing a top–to-bottom review and scrub of every single sound in the game. We have a renewed focus on the audio in the game and you should stay tuned for further improvements as we go through the SFX.

[h1]UGC[/h1]

Another area of the game that was improved is our UGC Hub. You will notice a refreshed layout that should let you see all of your content much easier. 

[h1]GRAPHICS[/h1]

Graphics are much improved in this update as well. We had two key areas of focus: The first was to finish rolling out our Screen Space Reflections feature to all objects in game. We think it looks beautiful and hope you agree too! Here’s a a peak at what it looks like and how its improved water and other objects in the scene:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/ss05182016.jpg[/img]

Additionally, our team took a look at all of our Terrain Shaders and improved the system to support much higher quality terrain and better mixing of different terrains. This improvement should further add depth and immersion as you play. 

On top of this we added a nifty Depth-of-Field effect to the main park view. Objects further away will be blurry and those closer will be crystal clear. [b]This effect is DISABLED by default. To turn it on simply go to Options > Graphics  and disable the Depth–of-Field effect.[/b]

Work was also done on a number of flatrides to optimize them and also to up-res their textures [i](In Progress Work)[/i]. We won’t be highlighting them in this update blog as they’re not fully rolled out, but the results are already showing an increase in overall performance while at the same time allowing us to have gorgeous hi-res textures and smoother animations! This is available today on some of your rides and will be rolled out to the remaining rides in future updates. 

[img][/img][h1]PERFORMANCE[/h1]

Last, but certainly not least, in general you should notice that your game will run a bit smoother due to the above optimizations but also due a number of other “under-the-hood” changes. More work is of course continuing on performance and we have some longer term tasks we hope to wrap up in the coming weeks to continue making the game perform better. 

It’s been an insanely busy few weeks here at Team RCTW as we work to improve the game, launch new content and features, and fix bugs. Your feedback is driving all of our decisions and we hope you like  the direction the game is taking. Be sure to continue to share your [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]thoughts[/url], [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]bug reports[/url], and more with us on our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]forums[/url].

From our Community Team, here’s a sneak peek at this week’s Community Spotlight – a park called "Timeless Isle" by user "Maulite":

[img]https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/t31.0-8/13246207_1054797834612387_5080743826880113701_o.jpg[/img]

For more screenshots from his park check out our [url=https://www.facebook.com/media/set/?set=a.1054797721279065.1073741836.121146194644227&type=3]Facebook Album[/url].

Thank you again for all the support, incredible feedback, and most importantly – the amazing and inspiring creations and parks you all are making!

Until the next post, see you on the [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]forums[/url]! In the meantime, see below for the full list of what’s contained in this update and to get a preview at what we are working on next!

notes.title: RCTW - Early Access - Dev Blog #7 - Update #4 Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,

It’s time for our next update! This update contains a number of “under-the-hood” fixes, improvements, and a few new in-progress features.  As we continue with our production timeline, some updates or patches, like this one, may have less immediately obvious visual impact in-game. However, it’s important to know that the changes now being made to the core infrastructure of RCTW will pay enormous dividends as we continue through and beyond Early Access. 

In the last few weeks, our focus has been on AI. This is NOT the final AI update, but rather our first patch on the system since Early Access launched.  You will notice peep bathroom and staff behavior are improved.  Park staff will now better spread themselves around your park and janitors will clean up messes in a more orderly fashion.  As a head’s up, you might have to adjust the number of staff in your park for better results. Additionally, peep emotes and thoughts are improved and more helpful!  Let us know what you think by visiting our “[url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]Early Access Forums[/url]”.

As before, our plan is to make incremental improvements on a variety of systems, see what you think, make sure we are going in the right direction, and then expand on those improvements. So to reiterate - while AI has had a major overhaul, it is just the start of all the improvements we want to do to the system. We need your [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]feedback[/url] to make sure we are on the right track! 

In other news, we have also improved certain game visuals. We’ve increased the texture quality of all our peeps and improved the level of details on various scenery items.  Also, in this update, you will have your first peek at our new Screen Space Reflections system; it is not fully implemented yet and still in development, but look out for new reflections that have been added to a number of objects. We, however, will reserve the before-and-after screenshots for when the feature is fully implemented. 

Lastly, but certainly not least, some of you may have noticed that the Adventure Ruins centerpiece scenery object snuck into our last update. We have improved the visuals a bit and are now officially releasing it! It’s exciting to see how much everyone is loving these bigger centerpiece scenery objects, so expect us to add more as we go! 

Check it out: 

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/282560_20160503103052_1.png[/img]
[I]This is the new Adventure Ruins Centerpiece![/I]

It’s been a busy few weeks here at Team RCTW. Team RCTW

[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] Tool tip placement is now more consistent throughout the entire UI.
[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] Updated the finance screen to now fit 5 columns of data. 
[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] Updated the sci-fi arch screenshots.
[*][b]UI/UX:[/b] When in the track tab, putting the cursor on the HUD and back out again will no longer cause you to lose your current segment selection.[/list]

[u][b]ALPHA FEATURES – IN PROGRESS - FEEDBACK NEEDED[/b][/u]

That said, you may need to adjust the number of janitor buildings and staff to make sure your park is nice and tidy![/list][/list]

[*][b]Coasters:[/b] Twisting a coaster track using the second edit mode will focus the rotation in the middle of the segment

[*][b]Localization:[/b] Lots of text is missing in French
[*][b]Paths:[/b] No assets can be placed on paths 
[*][b]Peeps:[/b] Park staff and rotated incorrectly while walking
[*][b]Peeps:[/b] Peep body clips with the fences of the “Typhoon Ride”
[*][b]Peeps:[/b] Peeps are not getting injured from coaster crash
[*][b]Peeps:[/b] Peeps are not using the correct animation based on their age and gender
[*][b]Peeps:[/b] Peeps not properly holding items when walking around your park

[*][b]UGC:[/b] UGC voting feature has a variety of bugs

Our focus on Early Access is getting updates out faster to you so that we can get feedback earlier in the process. Feedback on what you seeing implemented should go [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]HERE[/url].

Already, in our next major update, some improvements will be noticeable. Of course, we have planned a few surprises along the way as well! 

We also have noted a number of users asking about performance improvements. While performance will improve incrementally with each update, we do have a number of larger initiatives underway that we expect will solve the problem more holistically. Those, however, are taking some time to implement. We will share more updates once we get a bit further along.

notes.title: RCTW - Early Access - Dev Blog #7 - Update #4 Now Live!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,

It’s time for our next update! This update contains a number of “under-the-hood” fixes, improvements, and a few new in-progress features.  As we continue with our production timeline, some updates or patches, like this one, may have less immediately obvious visual impact in-game. However, it’s important to know that the changes now being made to the core infrastructure of RCTW will pay enormous dividends as we continue through and beyond Early Access. 

In the last few weeks, our focus has been on AI. This is NOT the final AI update, but rather our first patch on the system since Early Access launched. As a head’s up, you might have to adjust the number of staff in your park for better results. Additionally, peep emotes and thoughts are improved and more helpful!  Let us know what you think by visiting our “[url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]Early Access Forums[/url]”.

As before, our plan is to make incremental improvements on a variety of systems, see what you think, make sure we are going in the right direction, and then expand on those improvements. We need your [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]feedback[/url] to make sure we are on the right track! 

In other news, we have also improved certain game visuals. We’ve increased the texture quality of all our peeps and improved the level of details on various scenery items. We, however, will reserve the before-and-after screenshots for when the feature is fully implemented.

notes.title: RCTW - Early Access - ICYMI April 25 - Community Spotlight - UGC by 'WoodenCode' / Guide by 'Shirty'
notes.content:
Hi all,

In case you missed it, last week we featured User Generated Content by 'WoodenCode' in our Community Spotlight! Check out his [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/woodencode/myworkshopfiles/?appid=282560]RCTW Steam Workshop Profile[/url] to see and download some of the incredible stuff he has made - including a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=677812766]real-time map scenery object[/url] that updates as you build your park!

Here's the full post by Community Manager - 'Nookriot':

[quote=Nookriot on April 27 via Social Media]
Evening Tycoon Fans!

Checking in on the Community Spotlight to share some pretty sweet UGC this week with you all. The community member we are featuring is WoodenCode! [b]The specific piece that caught our eye is an in-game real-time park map that updates as you shape and expand your park.[/b] He has also created some really cool RCTW in-game signage. notes.title: RCTW - Early Access - Dev Blog #6 - Improved Coaster Physics!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons,

After much development, testing, and feedback following our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/282560/announcements/detail/626373163241964546]last blog[/url] (please keep it coming), we are happy to release update #3!
 
For this update we really focused on improving our coasters. Based on your feedback, we made adjustments to our physics system, stats and pre-made coasters. First you will notice that our pre-made coasters are new and improved! They have been updated to look and behave more realistically. For those of you who have a pre-made coaster in your park currently, you may need to replace it with one of our updated versions to ensure it works properly.

We also made an update to our physics system. Your coasters will now react more realistically to your track designs. As a result of these updates, some of your previous designs may need to be tweaked a bit. 

For those longtime RCT fans, you will also notice we have added a new feature called “Grease Your Tracks.” When you check this box it will ease the friction and the physics will be a bit looser. Test it out, and see how you like it!

Additionally, we’re launching new highly requested features, including an RGB color picker for your coaster tracks. We are going to call this particular feature at “Alpha Stage”, because it is the very first step to a larger system, and we plan to spend more time fixing bugs associated with it. That said, it’s just too cool not to release today!

On the art side, we are currently developing new content such as this new Gold Mine Scenery Centerpiece (released today). This scenery item will allow you to build coasters and paths through its tunnels, giving a unique look and feel to your park. Take a look:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/RollerCoaster-Tycoon-World-2016-04-18-19-54-59-40-1.jpg[/img][i]Check out the awesome new Gold Mine scenery centerpiece! It has tunnels big enough to fit a coaster through. The two mountains connected by the bridge are all one piece.[/i]

Water is important to us and with the feedback received, we wanted to refine the water and address some feedback for this update. We added dynamic real-time reflections and also tweaked some of the water shaders for increased realism. Check it out:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/comparison_3.jpg[/img][i]This image shows the difference in water from before to now.[/i]

Lastly, we spent a considerable amount of time improving existing features and, of course, fixing bugs! In particular, we wanted to mention we made a number of bug-fixes associated with UGC downloading issues.

See below for the full list of what’s contained in this update and to get a peek at what we are working on next!

[b][u]NEW FEATURES AND CONTENT[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]Coasters:[/b] [i]Added an RGB color chooser for tracks![/i] *NOTE – this feature is still in Alpha and will be expanded and improved upon in the future.
[*][b]Coasters:[/b] [i]Grease your tracks option added to the coaster tool![/i] Want to keep your coaster physics similar to what they were prior to this update? Simply check off the “Grease your Tracks” option in the coaster builder. 
[*][b]Content:[/b] [i]Added spotlights to your Décor scenery.[/i] Cool new ways to light up your park and rides at night! 
[*][b]Content:[/b] [i]Added new Western Gold Mine scenery to Centerpieces.[/i] This new scenery item is a beautiful big centerpiece that has mineshafts and tunnels through which you can run your coasters and paths!
[*][b]Graphics:[/b] [i]Added real-time reflections to water.[/i] The water now accurately and beautifully reflects the environment and objects around it.
[*][b]UGC:[/b] [i]Added a button/ranking system to In-Game Hubs.[/i] Players can now vote on their favorite UGC items via the in-game hubs. Those rankings will now be displayed in both the Steam Workshop and In-Game.
[/list]
[b][u]IMPROVEMENTS[/u][/b][list]
[*][b]AI:[/b] Janitors and Mechanics are much more effective reducing overall urine/puke in the park.
[*][b]Animations:[/b] Improved animation for children peeps on Helter Skelter and Hay Rides.
[*][b]Animations:[/b] Improved animation for mechanics and medics. 
[*][b]Animations:[/b] Numerous general animation improvements.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Physics:[/b] Friction on coasters should now be much closer to real world values.[list]
[*][i]Note:[/i] This means you may need to tweak prior coaster designs to ensure they still run properly. If you want to ease the friction and physics simply check off the “Grease Your Tracks” option in the coaster builder. 
[*][i]Note 2:[/i] We are still working on Coaster Physics and Stats but we wanted to release this incremental update not only to show progress but also to ensure we are headed in the right direction. Please give us feedback![/list]
[*][b]Pre-Made Coasters:[/b] We have updated many of the pre-made coasters to make them work with the new physics. They now have the new friction system in mind, better stats, and also reflect higher levels of realism. This process however is still on-going.
[*][b]Stats:[/b] Banking curves now reduces the lateral G’s generated further than before.
[*][b]Stats:[/b] Coaster stats should be easier to keep below 12 intensity – watch your lateral G’s though![/list]
[*][b]Graphics:[/b] We have done our “First” pass on sci-fi textures. We are in the process of revamping all of the sci-fi textures to make them better and more realistic. Let us know what you think!
[*][b]UGC:[/b] Manual Refresh Button added. We have added a manual refresh button to the in-game UGC tools to allow you to manually refresh your content.
[*][b]UGC:[/b] Paging System Added. Just like on the Steam Workshop you now have the option to page through content in-game to make it easier to find improving the user experience.
[*][b]UX/UI:[/b] Park expansion button moved into the main HUD so it’s more visible.[/list]
[b][u]BUG FIXES[/u][/b]
The team has been hard at work fixing bugs! Below is a partial list of some of the more notable ones. [i]NOTE - There are additional fixes not included in this list.[/i][list]
[*][b]Audio[/b]	Sound of the game is audible even if the game is minimized by using Alt+Tab.
[*][b]Audio[/b]	Sounds of Peeps needing to go to the bathroom shouldn't be heard in rides
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Building cannot be rotated while the grid is active
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Building who cannot be attached to paths
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Drop Zone - Previous and Next button of ride camera is not working for the ride Drop Zone.
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Entry path gets detached when placing the restaurant building 'Log Cabin Restaurant' rotating 90 degrees.
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Flat ride - Incomplete description is given in the preview window of the 'Pendulum' ride.
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Spacewars flatride goes into ride cam when selecting it to build.
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Tornado - Ride cars illuminate during day and night if user zooms in and out the camera.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	A twisted track appears at the end of 'Specialty Pieces'.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	An incorrect game tip regarding the Queue and Path lines is displayed after placing a coaster into the park.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Coaster builder segment mode get locked once you use freeform
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Mechanism value not rounded when switching between chain lift speed and other mechanisms strength value.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Ride Sign' placed over the queue path attached to a completed coaster (Track loop closed) displays 'Testing' on the sign board, even though the coaster is closed.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Spinning coaster supports are detached from the coaster track.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Test Results & Ride Stats - Speed tab automatically gets selected even if the user has selected any other tab in the Test Results & Ride Stats.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	The blue coaster node for 'Auto complete?' becomes un-intractable, if user slightly twists the last track node after completing the coaster track.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	The red color appears on the track of the spinning coaster if user apply the mechanism 'Friction Break' to the tracks.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	User is unable to close coaster editor toolbar by clicking on the cross button.
[*][b]General[/b]	 Save Load not working.
[*][b]General[/b]	Camera stuck outside of the park while building a roller coaster with very low framerate.
[*][b]General[/b]	Campaign - Objective set #6 second objective cannot be completed stuck at 20%
[*][b]General[/b]	Incorrect game tip regarding Medic staff patrol time is observed on loading screen.
[*][b]General[/b]	Loading Screen - Game tips - Incorrect game tip regarding Mechanics petrol time is observed on loading screen.
[*][b]General[/b]	Sandbox flatland open does not work
[*][b]General[/b]	Save System - Terrain does not change from one instance to another
[*][b]General[/b]	Saved Games - Entrance path ghost is broken at first boot
[*][b]General[/b]	Scenario 1 boot at max speed en if the UI shows minimum speed
[*][b]General[/b]	Scenario work flow fix
[*][b]Graphics[/b]	Distant trees outside the park have wrong shader.
[*][b]Graphics[/b]	If the user proceeds into the map for the first time, a white patch appears on the 'Warning' message box near 'Ok' button.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Fix the teen peeps skins
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Medics freeze on large paths.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Mechanics flickering at the building entrance
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	One of the female peep dressed in a orange dress appears to be sited on the ground rather on chair.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peep get stuck at ride exits.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peep thoughts are disappearing.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peep will clip through the seat of the 'Wild Tycoon Wings'.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peeps are not visible on flat rides or coasters.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peeps clip with the car of the ride 'Zipper'.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peeps never attempt to grab handles of the harness in 'Pendulum' ride.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Sometimes the medic staff gets stuck at one place in a walking animation.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Staff - Tool Box of mechanic clips with the body.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Staff can be seen sliding on path
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Staff do not enter their buildings.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Stretching peeps can be seen everywhere
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Texture issue with Peep
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	The way adults sit and children sit is not properly differentiating
[*][b]UGC[/b]	Some users cannot download UGC
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Cannot change game speed with mouse left clicking.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Cannot select the park entrance on 2 maps.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Finances - On hovering the cursor over the last tab of the Finances only Loans appears as the tooltip.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Luminous Isle - Modify Terrain - 'Grass texture D' is displayed in the description of the paint theme 'Grass Texture A'.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Objective tab is a bit out of the screen
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Objective text does not show up in Scenario 2.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Theme icons for some of the fences overlaps with their preview images.[/list]
[b][u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u][/b]
We are still working on a number of bugs, tweaks, and other fixes. In particular, we’re focusing on the 57% loading bug. While we work to resolve this and other issues with future updates, we wanted to call out an excellent guide made by a member of our community that, in the interim, has helped resolve a number of issues for users experiencing the 57% bug, blackscreen issues, or similar problems. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=660997633]Please check it out![/url] 

Additionally, it’s super important for you to continue to give us [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]feedback[/url], [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]suggest improvements[/url], and [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]report bugs[/url]! We are reading it all and prioritizing our work based on what you tell us.

[b][u]WHAT’S NEXT[/u][/b]
With our first major pass on coaster physics now done our team is shifting its focus to all things AI for our next big update. We want to make sure that the staff functions more efficiently, your peeps are smarter, and that in general your park feels more responsive to what you are building and doing. Of course we will also continue to iterate on what we have released and improved thus far!

A side note on paths – we are aware of the frustrations people are experiencing with paths. We have read your feedback and are working on the overall path system. While the fixes won’t be included in our next update, know that we are working hard on these improvements. 

In terms of peeps and their animation - We have read your comments and are working hard on improving our animation system as well as our peeps quality – we will have more news on this once we progress further on this effort. 

The whole team is feeling inspired and we hope you find time to share some of the great stuff you are making in our new [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?51-Creativity]Creativity Forum[/url]! Also be sure to check out our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?1-RollerCoaster-Tycoon-World]Forums[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/rollercoastertycoon/]Social Media pages[/url] as our community team will be featuring more and more user-made creations and parks! 

Here’s a sneak peek at a park by fan "Deathtome" which we will be featuring this week:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/DeathtomePreview1.jpg[/img][i]This park by fan "Deathtome" will be featured this week on [url=https://www.facebook.com/rollercoastertycoon/]Social Media[/url] so be sure to check it out![/i]

Thank you for all the support, the incredible feedback, and the awesome creations we are seeing. 

Team RCTW

[*][b]AI:[/b] Janitors and Mechanics are much more effective reducing overall urine/puke in the park.
[*][b]Animations:[/b] Improved animation for children peeps on Helter Skelter and Hay Rides.
[*][b]Animations:[/b] Improved animation for mechanics and medics. 
[*][b]Animations:[/b] Numerous general animation improvements.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]:[list]
[*][b]Physics:[/b] Friction on coasters should now be much closer to real world values.[list]
[*][i]Note:[/i] This means you may need to tweak prior coaster designs to ensure they still run properly. If you want to ease the friction and physics simply check off the “Grease Your Tracks” option in the coaster builder. 
[*][i]Note 2:[/i] We are still working on Coaster Physics and Stats but we wanted to release this incremental update not only to show progress but also to ensure we are headed in the right direction. Please give us feedback![/list]
[*][b]Pre-Made Coasters:[/b] We have updated many of the pre-made coasters to make them work with the new physics. They now have the new friction system in mind, better stats, and also reflect higher levels of realism. This process however is still on-going.
[*][b]Stats:[/b] Banking curves now reduces the lateral G’s generated further than before.
[*][b]Stats:[/b] Coaster stats should be easier to keep below 12 intensity – watch your lateral G’s though![/list]
[*][b]Graphics:[/b] We have done our “First” pass on sci-fi textures. We are in the process of revamping all of the sci-fi textures to make them better and more realistic. Let us know what you think!
[*][b]UGC:[/b] Manual Refresh Button added. We have added a manual refresh button to the in-game UGC tools to allow you to manually refresh your content.
[*][b]UGC:[/b] Paging System Added. Just like on the Steam Workshop you now have the option to page through content in-game to make it easier to find improving the user experience.
[*][b]UX/UI:[/b] Park expansion button moved into the main HUD so it’s more visible.[/list]
[b][u]BUG FIXES[/u][/b]
The team has been hard at work fixing bugs! Below is a partial list of some of the more notable ones. [i]NOTE - There are additional fixes not included in this list.[/i][list]
[*][b]Audio[/b]	Sound of the game is audible even if the game is minimized by using Alt+Tab.
[*][b]Audio[/b]	Sounds of Peeps needing to go to the bathroom shouldn't be heard in rides
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Building cannot be rotated while the grid is active
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Building who cannot be attached to paths
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Drop Zone - Previous and Next button of ride camera is not working for the ride Drop Zone.
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Entry path gets detached when placing the restaurant building 'Log Cabin Restaurant' rotating 90 degrees.
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Flat ride - Incomplete description is given in the preview window of the 'Pendulum' ride.
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Spacewars flatride goes into ride cam when selecting it to build.
[*][b]Buildings[/b]	Tornado - Ride cars illuminate during day and night if user zooms in and out the camera.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	A twisted track appears at the end of 'Specialty Pieces'.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	An incorrect game tip regarding the Queue and Path lines is displayed after placing a coaster into the park.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Coaster builder segment mode get locked once you use freeform
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Mechanism value not rounded when switching between chain lift speed and other mechanisms strength value.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Ride Sign' placed over the queue path attached to a completed coaster (Track loop closed) displays 'Testing' on the sign board, even though the coaster is closed.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Spinning coaster supports are detached from the coaster track.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	Test Results & Ride Stats - Speed tab automatically gets selected even if the user has selected any other tab in the Test Results & Ride Stats.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	The blue coaster node for 'Auto complete?' becomes un-intractable, if user slightly twists the last track node after completing the coaster track.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	The red color appears on the track of the spinning coaster if user apply the mechanism 'Friction Break' to the tracks.
[*][b]Coasters[/b]	User is unable to close coaster editor toolbar by clicking on the cross button.
[*][b]General[/b]	 Save Load not working.
[*][b]General[/b]	Camera stuck outside of the park while building a roller coaster with very low framerate.
[*][b]General[/b]	Campaign - Objective set #6 second objective cannot be completed stuck at 20%
[*][b]General[/b]	Incorrect game tip regarding Medic staff patrol time is observed on loading screen.
[*][b]General[/b]	Loading Screen - Game tips - Incorrect game tip regarding Mechanics petrol time is observed on loading screen.
[*][b]General[/b]	Sandbox flatland open does not work
[*][b]General[/b]	Save System - Terrain does not change from one instance to another
[*][b]General[/b]	Saved Games - Entrance path ghost is broken at first boot
[*][b]General[/b]	Scenario 1 boot at max speed en if the UI shows minimum speed
[*][b]General[/b]	Scenario work flow fix
[*][b]Graphics[/b]	Distant trees outside the park have wrong shader.
[*][b]Graphics[/b]	If the user proceeds into the map for the first time, a white patch appears on the 'Warning' message box near 'Ok' button.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Fix the teen peeps skins
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Medics freeze on large paths.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Mechanics flickering at the building entrance
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	One of the female peep dressed in a orange dress appears to be sited on the ground rather on chair.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peep get stuck at ride exits.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peep thoughts are disappearing.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peep will clip through the seat of the 'Wild Tycoon Wings'.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peeps are not visible on flat rides or coasters.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peeps clip with the car of the ride 'Zipper'.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Peeps never attempt to grab handles of the harness in 'Pendulum' ride.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Sometimes the medic staff gets stuck at one place in a walking animation.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Staff - Tool Box of mechanic clips with the body.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Staff can be seen sliding on path
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Staff do not enter their buildings.
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Stretching peeps can be seen everywhere
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	Texture issue with Peep
[*][b]Peeps[/b]	The way adults sit and children sit is not properly differentiating
[*][b]UGC[/b]	Some users cannot download UGC
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Cannot change game speed with mouse left clicking.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Cannot select the park entrance on 2 maps.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Finances - On hovering the cursor over the last tab of the Finances only Loans appears as the tooltip.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Luminous Isle - Modify Terrain - 'Grass texture D' is displayed in the description of the paint theme 'Grass Texture A'.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Objective tab is a bit out of the screen
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Objective text does not show up in Scenario 2.
[*][b]UI/UX[/b]	Theme icons for some of the fences overlaps with their preview images.[/list]
[b][u]KNOWN ISSUES[/u][/b]
We are still working on a number of bugs, tweaks, and other fixes. In particular, we’re focusing on the 57% loading bug. While we work to resolve this and other issues with future updates, we wanted to call out an excellent guide made by a member of our community that, in the interim, has helped resolve a number of issues for users experiencing the 57% bug, blackscreen issues, or similar problems. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=660997633]Please check it out![/url] 

Additionally, it’s super important for you to continue to give us [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?48-Early-Access-Sub-Forum]feedback[/url], [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]suggest improvements[/url], and [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]report bugs[/url]! We are reading it all and prioritizing our work based on what you tell us.

[b][u]WHAT’S NEXT[/u][/b]
With our first major pass on coaster physics now done our team is shifting its focus to all things AI for our next big update. We want to make sure that the staff functions more efficiently, your peeps are smarter, and that in general your park feels more responsive to what you are building and doing. Of course we will also continue to iterate on what we have released and improved thus far!

A side note on paths – we are aware of the frustrations people are experiencing with paths. We have read your feedback and are working on the overall path system. While the fixes won’t be included in our next update, know that we are working hard on these improvements. 

In terms of peeps and their animation - We have read your comments and are working hard on improving our animation system as well as our peeps quality – we will have more news on this once we progress further on this effort. 

The whole team is feeling inspired and we hope you find time to share some of the great stuff you are making in our new [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?51-Creativity]Creativity Forum[/url]! Also be sure to check out our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?1-RollerCoaster-Tycoon-World]Forums[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/rollercoastertycoon/]Social Media pages[/url] as our community team will be featuring more and more user-made creations and parks! 

Here’s a sneak peek at a park by fan "Deathtome" which we will be featuring this week:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/DeathtomePreview1.jpg[/img][i]This park by fan "Deathtome" will be featured this week on [url=https://www.facebook.com/rollercoastertycoon/]Social Media[/url] so be sure to check it out![/i]

Thank you for all the support, the incredible feedback, and the awesome creations we are seeing. 

Team RCTW

notes.title: RCTW - Early Access - Dev Blog #5 - New Typhoon Ride Released via "Mini" Update!
notes.content:
Dear Tycoons, 

First, thank you for the great response on our first major update, we are very happy to see that you are enjoying the improvements and are pleased with our direction – now it’s time for more!   

Although our plan is to do major updates along with smaller hotfixes as needed, today is a bit of an exception. So here it is, via a "mini" update – the Typhoon Ride!

[b][u]NEW CONTENT[/u][/b]

[b]New Typhoon Flat-Ride Available Now![/b]

As promised, we have been working hard on our Typhoon Ride, we now feel it is ready to share, so we’ve decided to push a small update for the weekend just for you.  Enjoy the ride!

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/New-Marketing-Shot-.png[/img]

[b][u]IMPROVEMENTS[/u][/b]

[b]Animations[/b]
We have seen a ton of feedback and video of peeps not sitting in rides correctly. With this update, we are addressing some of these concerns while we continue to work on additional improvements to the system to make it better:
[list]
[*][I]Age positions:[/I] Peeps now adjust their position according to age to avoid clipping;
[*][I]Peep AI:[/I] Peeps are now moving at all times; yes, they were sometimes flocking at the entrance of the park with some thoughts, and this has been fixed.[/list]

[b][u]FAN HIGHLIGHT[/u][/b]
Yesterday, we also showed off an AMAZING park being made by one of you using the latest update– community member – Maxfreak! You can see the full gallery on our [url=https://www.facebook.com/media/set/?set=a.1029515940473910.1073741830.121146194644227&type=3]Facebook Page[/url].

[img]https://scontent-yyz1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xtp1/t31.0-8/12967977_1029516417140529_6744240790536245782_o.jpg[/img]

[img]https://scontent-yyz1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpf1/t31.0-8/12973517_1029516473807190_4410015872707319756_o.jpg[/img]

[img]https://scontent-yyz1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xpa1/t31.0-8/12983359_1029516147140556_4355070501776871141_o.jpg[/img]

[img]https://scontent-yyz1-1.xx.fbcdn.net/hphotos-xfp1/t31.0-8/12983460_1029516537140517_3988284094062596627_o.jpg[/img]

Going forward, we are going to work with our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?1-RollerCoaster-Tycoon-World]community[/url] to make sure we highlight more awesome creations so be sure to join in on the fun on our forums. 

Thank you all for the awesome feedback on yesterday’s update and graphical improvements (we put too much emphasis on performance for our initial early access release; we are working towards the integration of our higher resolution assets – we are humbled by the reviews) – we know the visuals still aren’t where they need to be, we are working on this, but we are glad you all like the direction we are going in! 

To better illustrate the direction of our first update, see these additional before and after screenshots:

[img]http://www.rollercoastertycoon.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/RCTW-Comparision-2.jpg[/img]

[u][b]ROADMAP UPDATE[/b][/u]

We are currently working hard on our next major update that fixes known issues, adds additional improvements, and of course fixes bugs, as stated in our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/282560/announcements/detail/626373004003684213]prior blog[/url]. Please, continue to give us feedback. We do follow our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/282560/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url], [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?1-RollerCoaster-Tycoon-World]Official Forums[/url], and [url=https://www.facebook.com/rollercoastertycoon/]Social Media[/url] to learn about what needs to be fixed, improved, or added. However, please note the best place to report Bugs is on our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?50-Early-Access-Bug-Tracker]Bug Tracker[/url] and improvement requests should be reported to our [url=https://forum.rollercoastertycoon.com/forumdisplay.php?49-Early-Access-Improvement-Tracker]Improvement Tracker[/url]. 

If you liked the update, make sure you let us know too – its important your reviews are updated as we go as we go so that we know we are heading in the right direction! 

Thank you all for the support! Back to work for us, and have a great weekend!

See you in the park!
